title: Literature
tagline: Poetry, prose, drama and the novel of China, Japan and Korea, from the Book of Songs to Ōe Kenzaburō
hero_caption: Scene from the 'Yadorigi' chapter of the Genji monogatari emaki, illustrated handscroll of The Tale of Genji, 12th century
intro: The literatures of China, Japan and Korea from the Zhou-dynasty Book of Songs to the late twentieth century, told through their authors and key works: classical poetry in shi, ci, waka, haiku and sijo, essays and diaries, Yuan zaju, Noh and puppet drama, the great Ming and Qing novels, The Tale of Genji, and the modern fiction of Lu Xun, Sōseki and Yi Sang. Every author has a full biography and every work an introduction. Pictures are manuscripts, early printed editions, illustrated scrolls and woodblock prints from Wikimedia Commons; portraits are paintings and prints only, most of them later imagined likenesses, and works still in copyright are not reproduced.
